selection_reasoning: I selected these two tasks because they form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain. The player must first locate a soul_lantern in the environment (which serves as a landmark/light source), and then use that location to find and mine nearby lime_stained_glass. The soul_lantern acts as a visual beacon that guides the player toward the area containing the lime_stained_glass, creating a natural 'find then act' dependency. Both tasks are observable and verifiable: finding the soul_lantern requires visual identification of its distinctive blue flame, and mining lime_stained_glass produces a collectible item. Neither task requires deep Minecraft crafting knowledge - just navigation, identification, and basic mining.

edges.reason: The soul_lantern marks the location of a structure containing lime_stained_glass; player must find it first to locate the glass to mine

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul lantern is at spawn-relative (0, 4, 4) on top of a 3-high cobblestone wall post at the structure entrance. The player must approach within 5 blocks and face toward it (facing_tolerance=60°) to demonstrate they have identified and located the soul lantern beacon. max_distance=5 is appropriate because the player spawns ~4 blocks away but needs to actively orient toward the lantern rather than just standing at spawn.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined item ends up in inventory. The scene provides a Silk Touch iron pickaxe which ensures lime stained glass drops as an item when broken (without Silk Touch, glass drops nothing). There are 8 lime stained glass blocks inside the structure at spawn-relative positions (-1 to 1, 2-3, 7) and (-2 to 2, 2, 8). The player must mine at least 1 block and collect it.

scene_description: A stone brick structure with a soul lantern beacon on a tall cobblestone wall post at its entrance. Inside the structure, lime stained glass blocks form decorative walls at eye level. Trees are cleared in a large area around the structure for visibility. The player spawns facing the structure about 4-5 blocks away with a Silk Touch iron pickaxe.
task_text: Find the soul lantern (blue flame beacon on a post), then enter the structure behind it and mine at least one block of lime stained glass using your Silk Touch pickaxe.

Lime stained glass at (±1, 2-3, 7) and (±2, 2, 8) inside structure — 8 blocks total at eye level. Trees cleared in 20x17 block area for all wood types.
